run_find_all_nash_equilibria: run the matrix_nash_example to find all extreme Nash equilibria for a 2-player game using nashpy solver
run_find_pure_equilibria: run the matrix_nash_example to find all pure Nash equilibria for a constant-sum game
run_find_one_equilibrium: run the matrix_nash_example to find one Nash equilibrium using Lemke-Howson solver
run_solve_zero_sum_game: run the matrix_nash_example with linear solver to find equilibria for a zero-sum matrix game
run_reduce_dominated_actions: run the matrix_nash_example with iterated dominance to reduce strictly dominated actions before finding equilibria
